title: CHAPTER 2: THE DEFERRED LINE
ending: ECHO: The seals agree. PACKET and GHOST wrote those notes before they disappeared.
ECHO: The migration hold kept them in Q17. Delivery indexes 141 and 142 record their later dispatch.
SYSOP: The three retained modules rebuilt the local spool under the signed manifest. Dispatch is readable in a separate replay copy. The originals remain read-only.
ECHO: The queue reader recovered one more routing-table entry. Its destination is prepared. The registered-operator field is blank.
ECHO: Find UNASSIGNED in DEEP FIELD MESSAGES.
